business_problem: HubSpot's engineering, marketing, and customer success teams were spending too much time on migrations, maintenance, content creation, troubleshooting, and personalized follow-ups that did not scale across the organization.
solution_summary: HubSpot adopted Claude across multiple departments, with Claude Code doing the deepest integration work. Engineering connects Claude Code to internal services and the distributed codebase through MCP, using it for migrations, maintenance tasks, onboarding, and debugging. The team benchmarked real HubSpot engineering tasks and found Claude consistently needed the least human intervention, with Sonnet 4.5 reducing back-and-forth by asking for more missing context up front. Outside engineering, teams package reusable context in Claude projects and artifacts so marketing can centralize campaign information and create content faster, while customer success managers prepare for escalations, troubleshoot workflows, and generate tailored follow-ups in minutes instead of hours. This turns one-off manual knowledge work into reusable, shared AI workflows backed by HubSpot's own systems.
